All 13 tests pass. The implementation in `dominoes.py`:

- **`can_chain(dominoes)`** — returns `[]` for empty input, `None` if no chain exists, otherwise a list of tuples forming a closed chain.
- **`_is_chainable`** — quick necessary-condition check: a closed chain is an Eulerian circuit, so every vertex must have even degree and the graph must be connected. This prunes impossible cases (disconnected loops, odd-degree vertices) before searching.
- **`_search`** — backtracking search that tries each remaining domino in both orientations, only placing it if its left end matches the current chain end, and verifies the chain closes (first left end == last right end) when all dominoes are used.
